description.value: Fior di Latte began as a gelato shop in Burnaby's Hastings corridor in 2019 and has since grown into a full artisanal bakery-cafe offering scratch-made croissants, cakes, sandwiches, gelato, and specialty coffee. Known for inventive croissant flavors and a relaxed, work-friendly atmosphere, it has earned a strong local following and a 4.8-star reputation as a neighbourhood gem. Touring cyclists will find a genuine stop for a quality coffee and freshly baked goods with comfortable indoor seating.

bike_parking_detail: 8 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 10m; stands (2 spaces) at 19m; stands (2 spaces) at 19m; stands (2 spaces) at 32m; rack (3 spaces) at 84m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 91m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 92m; rack at 99m. Total: 19 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is rich and confirms the business is active: address (4233 Hastings Street, Burnaby), phone, and menu are all present. The About page embeds a TikTok noting 'a few electric outlets for your laptops', providing direct evidence for device charging. The product list explicitly includes a 'Gluten-Friendly Apple Muffin', confirming at least one GF option. No bike-specific amenities, washrooms, or water refill details appear anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM _community field says 'North Vancouver' but the business is clearly in Burnaby — the website explicitly states 'Proudly Serving the Burnaby Community' and 'Visit us at 4233 Hastings Street, Burnaby', and postal code V5C 2J5 is in Burnaby.

Two different phone numbers appear on the website: (604) 298-5955 on the front page Directions section, and 604-696-7557 in the footer across all other pages (About, Contact, Menu, Cart). The footer number 604-696-7557 is used here as it appears more consistently. The discrepancy should be verified.

OSM name 'Fiordilatte Gelateria & Cafe' differs from the website branding 'Fior Di Latte' / 'Fior di Latte' — the gelato/gelateria element is historical (started as gelato in 2019) and the current brand emphasizes pastries and cafe.
OSM phone field is empty; phone sourced entirely from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible artisanal bakery-cafe with a current website, confirmed address, and active product listings.
